dashboardQueries.name: 839f948b-96d7-4c60-b17b-126109f967ed
dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name = "Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type = "net_perf"
observer.hostname = /$sensor$/ nocase
additional.fields["trigger"] = "TS"
additional.fields["local_entity"] = "true"
$server_ip = if(principal.hostname != "-", principal.hostname, "unknown")

match:
    $server_ip
outcome:
    $crossings = sum(cast.as_float(additional.fields["crossings"]))
    $total_obs = sum(cast.as_float(additional.fields["total"]))
    $crossing_rate = math.round($crossings/$total_obs, 3)
    $worst_handshake_sec = math.round(max(if(additional.fields["max_val"] != "-" and additional.fields["max_val"] != "", cast.as_float(additional.fields["max_val"]), 0.0)), 3)
    $last_seen = timestamp.get_timestamp(max(metadata.event_timestamp.seconds), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
order:
   $crossings desc
limit:
    25

dashboardQueries.name: 990842dc-a2f0-4843-9478-240c36ea7573
dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name = "Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type = "net_perf"
observer.hostname = /$sensor$/ nocase
additional.fields["trigger"] = /$trigger$/ nocase

$scope = if(additional.fields["local_entity"] = "T", "Internal Entity", if(additional.fields["local_entity"] = "F", "External Entity", if(re.regex(additional.fields["trigger"], `^(DD|TH|QH|HH)$`), "External Entity", "Unknown")))
match:
    $question, $scope
outcome:
    $crossings = sum(cast.as_int(additional.fields["crossings"]))

dashboardQueries.name: a69ce387-4fd2-4771-9018-c51fbfc956e2
dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name = "Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type = "net_perf"
observer.hostname = /$sensor$/ nocase
additional.fields["trigger"] = /$trigger$/ nocase
$question = if(re.regex(additional.fields["trigger"], `^(RS|RC)$`), "Path latency", if(re.regex(additional.fields["trigger"], `^(DS|DD)$`), "DNS response time", if(re.regex(additional.fields["trigger"], `^(TS|TH)$`), "TLS handshake time", if(re.regex(additional.fields["trigger"], `^(QS|QH)$`), "QUIC handshake time",if(re.regex(additional.fields["trigger"], `^(HS|HH)$`), "HTTP request/response time", if(additional.fields["trigger"] = "B", "Byte volume", "Other"))))))
match:
    $question
outcome:
    $c = sum(cast.as_int(additional.fields["crossings"]))
    $a = arrays.index_to_str(array_distinct(if(re.regex(additional.fields["trigger"], `^(RS|RC)$`), "Path latency", if(re.regex(additional.fields["trigger"], `^(DS|DD)$`), "DNS response time", if(re.regex(additional.fields["trigger"], `^(TS|TH)$`), "TLS handshake time", if(re.regex(additional.fields["trigger"], `^(QS|QH)$`), "QUIC handshake time",if(re.regex(additional.fields["trigger"], `^(HS|HH)$`), "HTTP request/response time", if(additional.fields["trigger"] = "B", "Byte volume", "Other"))))))), 0)
    $top_question = strings.concat($a, " (", cast.as_string($c), ")")
order:
    $c desc
limit:
    1

dashboardQueries.name: a72ba65d-6a0a-4d72-9e13-e849f3935438
dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name = "Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type = "net_perf"
observer.hostname = /$sensor$/ nocase
additional.fields["trigger"] = /$trigger$/ nocase
$performance_question = if(additional.fields["trigger"] = "RS", "Server RTT (path latency)", if(additional.fields["trigger"] = "RC", "Client RTT (path latency)", if(additional.fields["trigger"] = "DS", "DNS response time (by resolver)", if(additional.fields["trigger"] = "DD", "DNS response time (by domain)", if(additional.fields["trigger"] = "TS", "TLS handshake (by server IP)", if(additional.fields["trigger"] = "TH", "TLS handshake (by SNI)", if(additional.fields["trigger"] = "QS", "QUIC handshake (by server IP)", if(additional.fields["trigger"] = "QH", "QUIC handshake (by SNI)", if(additional.fields["trigger"] = "HS", "HTTP request/response (by server IP)", if(additional.fields["trigger"] = "HH", "HTTP request/response (by Host header)", if(additional.fields["trigger"] = "B", "IP byte volume", "Unknown")))))))))))
$uid = network.session_id
match:
    $uid
outcome:
    $performance_question_out = array_distinct($performance_question)
    $scope = array_distinct(if(additional.fields["local_entity"] = "T", "Internal", if(additional.fields["local_entity"] = "F", "External", if(re.regex(additional.fields["trigger"], `^(DD|TH|QH|HH)$`), "External (name-based)", "Unknown"))))
    $entity = array_distinct(if(principal.domain.name != "-", principal.domain.name, if(principal.hostname != "-", principal.hostname, "unknown")))
    $crossings = max(cast.as_float(additional.fields["crossings"]))
    $total_obs = max(cast.as_float(additional.fields["total"]))
    $worst_value = math.round(max(if(additional.fields["max_val"] != "-" and additional.fields["max_val"] != "", cast.as_float(additional.fields["max_val"]), 0.0)), 3)
    $window = max(network.session_duration.seconds)
    $reply_rate = array_distinct(additional.fields["reply_rate"])
    $sensor = array_distinct(observer.hostname)
    $when = timestamp.get_timestamp(max(metadata.event_timestamp.seconds), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    $target_dashboard = array_distinct(if(re.regex($performance_question, `^DNS`), "corelight_data_dns", if(re.regex($performance_question, `^HTTP`), "corelight_data_http", if(re.regex($performance_question, `^TLS`), "corelight_data_ssl", if(re.regex($performance_question, `^QUIC|^IP`), "corelight_data_connections", "unknown")))))
order:
    $when desc
limit:
    500

dashboardQueries.name: aa0b0738-6a47-4829-84aa-be1bd8bc37a3
dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name = "Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type = "net_perf"
observer.hostname = /$sensor$/ nocase
additional.fields["trigger"] = /$trigger$/ nocase
additional.fields["reply_rate"] != ""
$time_bucket = timestamp.get_timestamp(metadata.event_timestamp.seconds, "%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00", "UTC")
$rep_r = if(cast.as_float(re.capture(additional.fields["reply_rate"], `^(\d+)/`)) != 0 and cast.as_float(re.capture(additional.fields["reply_rate"], `/(\d+)$`)) > 0, cast.as_float(re.capture(additional.fields["reply_rate"], `^(\d+)/`)), 0.0)
$sent_r = if(cast.as_float(re.capture(additional.fields["reply_rate"], `^(\d+)/`)) != 0 and cast.as_float(re.capture(additional.fields["reply_rate"], `/(\d+)$`)) > 0, cast.as_float(re.capture(additional.fields["reply_rate"], `/(\d+)$`)), 1.0)
match:
    $time_bucket
outcome:
    $r_sum = sum($rep_r / $sent_r)
    $r_count = count($rep_r / $sent_r)
    $r = math.round($r_sum/$r_count, 2)
order:
    $time_bucket, $r asc
